messages:
Zoe (New Hire): Hi all, quick onboarding questions so I can finish setup:
1) I need to add my partner as a dependent for dental. What's the deadline and what docs do you need?
2) My commuter card arrived but "inactive" at the kiosk  who activates it?
3) I shipped boxes and paid fuel for the moving van  is mileage/gas reimbursable or only mover invoices?
4) I start 0.8 FTE  will holidays be prorated?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Zoe! :wave: Short answers:
1) Dependent enrollment window is 30 days from benefits eligibility. Docs: marriage cert or domestic partner affidavit + 1 proof of shared residence. Upload to benefits portal.
2) Commuter card activations are routed through payroll/benefits vendor. @Ken can trigger activation or reissue.
3) Policy: fuel/mileage for a personal vehicle is not covered; commercial mover invoices and temporary lodging are reimbursable up to policy caps. If you used a licensed carrier, submit that invoice under "Relocation - Moving Expense".
4) Holidays: yes prorated to 0.8 FTE based on calendar months remaining.

Ken (Payroll): Zoe  DM me last 4 of the card and the courier name. I can call the vendor to activate. For reimbursements: if you want it taxed as payroll (stipend) vs non-tax reimbursement, say so; payroll cutoffs apply (changes before Fri 6pm PST hit next run).

Olga (Benefits): If you run into file-type errors uploading partner docs, convert to PDF (300dpi) or PNG. If partner is abroad, passport + affidavit usually works. We'll hold enrollment pending any missing SSN.

Zoe (New Hire): Thanks! I'll upload docs now. If I submit the mover invoice, how long until reimbursement posts?

Ken (Payroll): After People Ops approval finance processes within 3-7 business days; if direct deposit not verified there may be delay. Check ADP bank verification.

Payroll Bot: Payroll cutoff reminder: next reimbursement run cutoff 2025-03-14 18:00 PST. Manual changes after cutoff apply to subsequent cycle. :robot_face:

Maya (People Ops): Zoe  ping me once you upload and I'll expedite approval so finance can pick it up on the next run. Congrats and welcome! :tada:
